segments.name: Medical devices business
segments.description: Sells medical devices and provides marketing promotion services, with operations centralized and financial results reviewed and managed on a consolidated basis.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single reportable segment, which is consistent with how the CODM, allocates resources and assesses performance.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for sales of medical devices and for marketing promotion services.
revenueModel.evidence: For the year ended March 31, 2026, three customers accounted for 31.9 %, 20.6 % and 10.5 % for the Company's total revenue from sales of medical devices business and marketing promotion service business.

changes.text: In 2023 the Company agreed to sell its Hong Kong and BVI subsidiaries and ceased to conduct its social e-commerce business, refocusing on its medical devices business.
changes.evidence: As a result of the Disposition, the Company will cease to conduct its social E—commerce business and focus on developing and investing resources into its medical devices business.
